html:
A veterinary surgeon who led the Gambia to independence in 1965 and was its prime minister and then president until 1994.

He led the People's Progressive Party, drawn largely from the Mandinka farmers of the river valley. Under him the Gambia kept a multiparty system with regular elections and a fairly free press, and it hosted the African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights. He survived the 1981 coup attempt only with Senegalese troops. In July 1994 young officers led by Yahya Jammeh overthrew him while he was away from the capital, and he went into exile, returning in 2002.
sum: A veterinary surgeon who led the Gambia to independence in 1965 and was its prime minister and then president until 1994.
